name: Jashwanth JP
kicker: Capturing the raw emotions of life's biggest days
role: Wedding & pre-wedding photographer — honest, heartfelt, timeless frames.
intro: Discover the heartfelt moments captured by JP
about: Hi, I'm Jashwanth, a wedding photographer who loves capturing real emotions and meaningful moments. I focus on telling stories through natural, heartfelt images. I believe the best photos are the ones that feel honest and timeless. Let's create memories you'll cherish forever.

points.d: I stay in the background and capture moments as they happen, not as they're posed.
Heartfelt images that follow the story of your day from first look to last dance.
Edits that feel true to the day and will still feel right decades from now.
Every frame is chosen to become a memory you'll want to hold on to.
